claims.locator: AUX AppendixA EqA5 PDF/printedp20; TableI p5; P18 TableI p3
claims.fact: GG Sigma is the Hermitian adjoint coordinate: complete real scalar potential uses TrSigma^2,TrSigma^3 and Psi-dagger Sigma Psi with no independent Sigma-dagger or added h.c.; complex Psi/Phi are explicitly conjugated. This fixes the ordinary real24, not an unconstrained complex24. Independent check: neutral Sigma8 gives b3=1/2 and Sigma3 b2=1/3 in threshold tables, the single-real-scalar coefficients T(R)/6, not complexT(R)/3. Therefore one irreducible-real24 module. This resolves earlier unestablished counting by source potential and degrees of freedom, not by assuming every real-type irrep is a real field.
